kamloops.title: Missing B.C. hiker found dead in Alberta national park
kamloops.description: Parks Canada said they received a report on July 23 that Bob Toothill, who was travelling the Great Divide Trail between Waterton Lakes National Park and Coleman, AB, was missing.

all.title: Cold front could escalate B.C. wildfires ahead of August long weekend
all.description: Strong winds and dry thunderstorms are expected to worsen wildfire conditions across southern B.C this long weekend, as more than 1,800 properties remain under evacuation orders.

all.title: Grinder, one of two beloved grizzly bears on Grouse Mountain, dies
all.description: Grinder, a massive grizzly bear who was adopted as a cub after being orphaned, and fascinated locals and tourists alike on Grouse Mountain, has died.
